answer: State the limit: sampling catches errors only in proportion to the sample. Audit 10 percent per epoch, 3 re-executions per 100 answers. Tax any attestation cluster from a single subnet by 50 percent. Draw auditors from a rotating pool of 200 keys. A farm of 50 puppets on one mesa faces that tax on every answer and 5 sampled answers per epoch. Over 20 epochs the tax bill passes the zenith of its payout and drains the vault.
